lead.headline: 31.8 behind; Barkley alone tonight
lead.deck: Gadsden's 0.0 and a 49ers D/ST that scored 1 turned the week into a 1% chance.
lead.body: Oronde Gadsden ran a route on three of every four pass plays at Buffalo and was targeted on 7% of them, catching none, and the 49ers D/ST scored 1 after allowing 30. MarShawn Lloyd was Green Bay's third back on Thursday, 15 snaps behind Brooks and Johnson. Bloodsports trail JuiceJam 89.8 to 121.5, and Saquon Barkley needs 31.8 tonight at Chicago, where Case Keenum starts with Caleb Williams out. The lineup was the projection lineup. Josh Downs, 11 targets with Alec Pierce on IR, is the add if Lloyd's archive line confirms the demotion and Downs clears waivers at 01:00 Wednesday.
